description:
## Why

Per parent PKIX-77cl design §6: the 4 §4.5 FAIL cases fail because the EE is revoked on a self-issued-signed CRL. They must live in pkix-revocation tests, not pkix-path.

## Scope (this PR only)

1. Add `pkix-revocation/tests/pkits_helper.rs` (or extend if it exists) with a new `pkits_validate_with_crls(cert_names, crl_names, now_unix)` helper (~50 LOC) that runs path validation with CRL revocation checking.
2. Add `pkix-revocation/tests/pkits_4_5.rs` with all 8 §4.5 cases:
   - 4 PASS: 4.5.1, 4.5.3, 4.5.4, 4.5.6 (revocation check passes — EE not on CRL)
   - 4 FAIL: 4.5.2, 4.5.5, 4.5.7, 4.5.8 (EE revoked on self-issued-signed CRL — assert revoked variant)

## Independence from chain_walk refactor

Per parent bead §8: this PR can land in parallel with PKIX-als9 chain_walk refactor. PR-1 already provides the regression-protective baseline; this PR adds full coverage including revocation paths.

## Implementation notes

- Need to read pkix-revocation public API to determine the right helper signature.
- CRL fixtures already at `pkix-path/tests/pkits/crls/` — pkix-revocation test harness needs to load them from there (cross-crate path) or have its own copy.
- FAIL assertion: pin the exact `pkix_revocation::Error` (or whatever the path-with-revocation result type returns) for revoked status.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `pkix-revocation/tests/pkits_4_5.rs` exists with 8 tests.
- [ ] Helper function loads + parses CRLs and runs through pkix-revocation's RevocationChecker.
- [ ] All 8 tests pass: `cargo test -p pkix-revocation --test pkits_4_5`.
- [ ] FAIL cases assert variant-precise revocation errors.
- [ ] Tests are fully offline.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --all-features -p pkix-revocation -- -D warnings` clean.

## Oracle

NIST PKITS vectors.json (`ShouldValidate` field) plus PKITS §4.5 narrative for failure mode classification.
notes:
Committed as 67d7bf99. 7 PASS+FAIL tests added in pkix-revocation/tests/pkits_4_5.rs. Cargo.toml [[test]] block gated on 'crl' feature.

Key implementation decisions:
1. Tests use direct CrlChecker::check_revocation calls (matching pkits_crl.rs style), not path+revocation integration via pkix_chain::verify_chain. The bead originally proposed a 'pkits_validate_with_crls' multi-CRL helper but the indirect-CRL semantics in §4.5 (CRL signer differs from cert issuer) are not supported in pkix-revocation v0.1 path-level integration — deferred to v0.2.

2. Each test explicitly identifies the CRL signer cert (via AKI match against bundle) and supplies it as 'issuer' to check_revocation. Documented inline in the file header.

3. Scope correction: §4.5.8 is NOT a revocation failure (PKITS narrative: 'The end entity's certificate was signed using the CRL signing key' — i.e., signed by cRLSign-only cert without BasicConstraints). It belongs to PR-1 (pkix-path) and was added in commit 39d56b27.

Final corrected split:
- pkix-path/tests/pkits_4_5.rs: 5 tests (4.5.1, .3, .4, .6 PASS, 4.5.8 FAIL).
- pkix-revocation/tests/pkits_4_5.rs: 7 tests (4.5.1, .2, .3, .4, .5, .6, .7).

cargo fmt + clippy --all-features -p pkix-revocation --tests + full workspace test all clean.
title: PR-2: pkix-revocation PKITS §4.5 full suite (all 8 cases including 4 revocation FAIL)
